department: Doctoral School Electronics, Electrical Energy, Automatic Control, Signal Processing (ED EEATS)

deadline.value: The 2026-2027 EEATS contract round closed on 31 May 2026, and no 2027 round is published.

also.quote: Dépôt des candidatures par les candidats sur ADUM | du 02/03/2026 au 31/05/2026

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the EEATS pages.

supervisor.value: You must be supervised by an HDR thesis director attached to the school, with a lab attached to the school.
supervisor.quote: Être encadré par un directeur de thèse HDR rattaché à l'ED EEATS.

funding.value: The school calls each year for applications for doctoral contracts, with pre-selection and auditions.
funding.quote: L'école doctorale lance chaque année un appel à candidatures pour l'attribution de contrats doctoraux | Auditions des candidats présélectionnés par le bureau de l’ED

entry_route.value: You need a French Master 2 (or equivalent) with at least an 'assez bien' mention; foreign Master's need an exemption from the CD3 commission.
entry_route.quote: Être titulaire d'un diplôme français de niveau Master 2 (ou autre diplôme conférant le grade de Master)

notes: A foreign Master-level degree requires a dispensation request to the school, examined by the CD3 commission. The school requires at least 36 months of funding.
